identity_anchor: The stylized Chinese character '支' (Zhi) with the distinct infinity-loop stroke at the bottom.
brand_cues_to_preserve: The specific calligraphic structure of the '支' character
The continuous loop connecting the vertical stroke to the bottom curve
The relative proportions of the upper horizontal strokes versus the lower loop
semantic_cues_to_preserve: The concept of flow and continuity implied by the loop
The stability of the character structure representing financial security
structure_policy_rationale: The reference analysis for Alipay explicitly demonstrates transforming the flat '支' character into a 3D ice pillar structure while strictly maintaining the original stroke topology. The identity of this app relies entirely on the specific geometry of the character; altering the structure would destroy recognition. Therefore, the mode is set to preserve the major structure, treating the logo as a mold for the ice sculpture.
design_rationale: Alipay's icon is a strong geometric logotype. Following the theme rules, we must discard the original brand blue and the 'AI' text label. The strategy is to extrude the existing 2D vector into a thick, translucent ice block. The bottom loop needs to look like a solid piece of frozen water curving back on itself. The 'AI' text is forbidden as it violates the minimalist ice aesthetic. The focus is purely on material translation: from flat white-on-blue to volumetric cyan-ice-on-white.
must_preserve: The exact silhouette of the '支' character
The connection point where the vertical line merges into the bottom loop
The thickness and roundness of the strokes (converted to 3D tube/block shape)
can_recompose: The internal texture (add bubbles/cracks inside the strokes)
The lighting angles (to highlight the curvature of the bottom loop)
The base structure (add a melted ice puddle underneath the character)
forbid: Retaining the original solid blue background
Including the 'AI' text at the bottom
Using opaque plastic or metal materials
Changing the stroke width ratios of the character
Floating the object without a ground shadow or ice base
generation_direction: Generate a 3D icon of the Alipay '支' character sculpted from translucent cyan ice. The character stands upright on a small block of melting ice against a pure white background. The material must show internal bubbles and subsurface scattering. No text, no original blue color. High gloss surface with soft studio lighting.
